name: Ibnsina Pharma S.A.E.
source: Ibnsina Pharma FY2025 audited consolidated earnings release (EGP, absolute)
source_note: Read from the issuer FY2025 earnings release balance sheet of 2 March 2026 (EGP, absolute). Total Assets equal Non-current Assets plus Current Assets exactly in both years. The printed subtotal labelled Total Liabilities repeats Total Assets in this release, so Total Liabilities here is Total Assets less Total Equity, which is 33,429,683,520 for FY2025 and 26,610,339,201 for FY2024, and the printed non-current liabilities tie to their own components. Current Liabilities is Total Liabilities less the printed non-current liabilities, and for FY2025 it also equals the sum of the printed current liability lines to the pound. Cash and Equivalents is the printed Cash on hand and at banks and matches the closing figure in the cash flow statement.
